C1409.title: South Korea Sets DeFi Precedent with First DEX Rug Pull Criminal Case
C1409.summary: The Seoul Southern District Prosecutors' Office arrested and indicted five suspects in South Korea's first criminal case involving a decentralized exchange rug pull. The suspects face charges of market manipulation and fraud, resulting in combined losses of 900 million won for 256 investors.
